reports.title: About this page
reports.query:
Twelve suppliers ship to six regional hubs, which serve five customer regions.

- **Map**: supplier → hub lanes
- **Sankey**: units shipped along each lane (from fulfilled orders)
- **Table**: supplier scorecard; ratings under 3.5 are highlighted

reports.title: Units by lane
reports.query:
// Units flowing supplier -> warehouse -> customer region
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[r:SHIPS_TO]->(w:Warehouse)
RETURN s AS source, r AS flow, w AS target
UNION ALL
MATCH (w:Warehouse)-[r:SERVES]->(g:Region)
RETURN w AS source, r AS flow, g AS target

reports.title: Supplier scorecard
reports.query:
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:City)-[:IN_COUNTRY]->(co:Country)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)
WITH s, c, co, count(p) AS products, round(avg(sup.leadTimeDays), 1) AS leadTime
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[sh:SHIPS_TO]->()
RETURN s.name AS Supplier, c.name + ', ' + co.name AS Location, products AS Products,
       leadTime AS `Avg lead time (days)`, sum(sh.units) AS `Units shipped`, s.rating AS Rating
ORDER BY Rating ASC

reports.title: Warehouse
reports.query:
MATCH (n:`Warehouse`) 
WHERE toLower(toString(n.`name`)) CONTAINS toLower($input) 
RETURN DISTINCT n.`name` as value,  n.`name` as display ORDER BY size(toString(value)) ASC LIMIT 5

reports.title: Late deliveries
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_FROM]->(w:Warehouse)
WHERE o.onTime IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce($neodash_warehouse_name, '') = '' OR w.name = $neodash_warehouse_name) AND NOT o.onTime
RETURN count(o)

reports.title: Average delay when late (days)
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_FROM]->(w:Warehouse)
WHERE o.onTime IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce($neodash_warehouse_name, '') = '' OR w.name = $neodash_warehouse_name) AND NOT o.onTime
RETURN round(avg(o.delayDays), 1)

reports.title: On-time delivery %
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_FROM]->(w:Warehouse)
WHERE o.onTime IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce($neodash_warehouse_name, '') = '' OR w.name = $neodash_warehouse_name)
RETURN toInteger(round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.onTime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(o)))

reports.title: On-time % by hub
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_FROM]->(w:Warehouse) WHERE o.onTime IS NOT NULL
RETURN w.name AS Hub, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.onTime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(o), 1) AS `On-time %`
ORDER BY `On-time %`

reports.title: On-time % by month
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_FROM]->(w:Warehouse)
WHERE o.onTime IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce($neodash_warehouse_name, '') = '' OR w.name = $neodash_warehouse_name)
RETURN date.truncate('month', o.date) AS Month, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.onTime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(o), 1) AS `On-time %`
ORDER BY Month

reports.title: Latest late deliveries
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:SHIPPED_FROM]->(w:Warehouse)
WHERE o.onTime IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce($neodash_warehouse_name, '') = '' OR w.name = $neodash_warehouse_name) AND NOT o.onTime
MATCH (cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o)
RETURN o.id AS Order, o.date AS Ordered, o.deliveredDate AS Delivered, o.delayDays AS `Delay (days)`, w.name AS Hub, cu.name AS Customer
ORDER BY Ordered DESC LIMIT 50

reports.title: Operations roadmap
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Project)-[:HAS_TASK]->(t:Task)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[n:NEXT]->(t2:Task)
RETURN t, n, t2

reports.title: Tasks
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Project)-[:HAS_TASK]->(t:Task)
RETURN p.name AS Project, t.name AS Task, t.startDate AS Start, t.endDate AS End, duration.inDays(t.startDate, t.endDate).days AS Days
ORDER BY Project, Start
